title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription for call queues
summary: The briefing's roadmap facts, licensing requirements and control paths are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting command documentation, distinguish unpublished recording-specific charges from general SharePoint storage costs, and remove a checklist command not represented in the controls table.

claims.claim: Create an Automatic Recording template at Teams admin center > Voice > Templates and resources > Templates > Automatic Recording > Add.
claims.quote: go to Voice > Templates and resources. ... Select Templates. ... Select Automatic Recording as the template type. ... Select Add to create a new Automatic Recording template.

claims.claim: The printed New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate call supplies the template's name, description, SharePoint location, document owner and enabled recording and transcription settings.
claims.quote: -Name <String> -Description <String> -SharePointHostName <String> -SharePointSiteName <String> -RecordingDocumentOwner <String> [-TranscriptionEnabled <Boolean>] [-RecordingEnabled <Boolean>]
claims.fix: Add to the notes accompanying the template-creation calls: 'The New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate syntax lists the announcement parameters as optional, but the parameter tables mark both as mandatory; Microsoft documentation is inconsistent.' The conflicting sections are on https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/new-csautorecordingtemplate.

claims.claim: Assign a template at Teams admin center > Voice > Call queue > call queue > Templates > Automatic recording template.
claims.quote: go to Voice > Call queue. ... Select the call queue you want to have automatic recording for. ... On the Templates tab, scroll to find the Automatic recording template section.

claims.claim: Set-CsCallQueue -Identity <queue GUID> -AutoRecordingTemplateId <template id> assigns the automatic recording template, subject to the printed preview warning.
claims.quote: Set-CsCallQueue -Identity <Guid> ... [-AutoRecordingTemplateId <String>] ... The AutoRecordingTemplateId parameter indicates the Auto Recording template to apply to the call queue.

claims.claim: The template creation path printed in controls[2] exposes representative recording-access settings.
claims.quote: Select Add to create a new Automatic Recording template. ... Select which call recordings call queue representatives (agents) can access.

claims.claim: The printed New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate call can grant agent access using -AgentViewPermission All.
claims.quote: [-AgentViewPermission <Object>] ... Are agents allowed to access the recordings or transcriptions. Supported values: None | All

claims.claim: The template creation path printed in controls[3] exposes recording-announcement configuration.
claims.quote: Select Add to create a new Automatic Recording template. ... Use the Default announcement or configure a Custom announcement.

claims.claim: The printed New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate call sets a caller announcement with -AutoRecordingAnnouncementTextToSpeechPrompt <t>.
claims.quote: [-AutoRecordingAnnouncementTextToSpeechPrompt <String>] ... The text to speech prompt that will be played to callers telling them their call is being recorded.

claims.claim: Assign Shared Call History at Teams admin center > Voice > Call queues > call queue > General info > Shared call history template.
claims.quote: go to Voice > Call queues. ... Select the call queue you want to have shared call history for. ... On the General info tab, scroll to find the Shared call history template section.

claims.claim: Set-CsCallQueue -Identity <queue GUID> -SharedCallQueueHistoryTemplateId <template id> applies a Shared Call History template.
claims.quote: The SharedCallQueueHistoryTemplateId parameter indicates the Shared Call History template to apply to the call queue. ... Shared call history is not availble when using a Teams channel for queue membership
claims.fix: Add to controls[4].note: 'The Set-CsCallQueue reference says Shared Call History is unavailable with Teams-channel queue membership, whereas the automatic-recording setup page permits group or channel membership and requires Shared Call History; these pages disagree.' Both reference pages are already cited.
